cl.x: Provide Sika® SealTape F where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (December 2025, Version 05.01).

Sika® SealTape F is an elastic system component which is used in combination with Sika®waterproofing products. It reduces the risk of leaks through potential cracking locations at wall corners, floor-to-wall connections, pipe entries etc.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.l: Crack-bridging and waterproofing tape used in combination with Sika® waterproofing products for reducing the risk of leakage at locations at risk to cracking for:
s: Residential or commercial wet areas
Cold storage areas, car washes and catering kitchens
Swimming pools and water retaining structures in combination with ceramic coverings
Balconies and terraces
Interior and exterior use
SikaCeram Sealing Membrane A
SikaTile - water-based waterproofing membranes
Davco under tile waterproofing Membrane
Sikalastic 1K

cl.x: Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (December 2025, Version 05.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Substrate Preparation
s: All substrates must be stable, clean, dry, free of any loose or friable particles, contaminants such as dust, dirt, oil, wax polish, grease, old adhesive residue, cement laitance or efflorescence. Smooth surfaces must be roughened lightly and dust removed to improve adhesion.
Surfaces shall be primed with a suitable primer prior to application. Refer to the selected Sika waterproofing membrane product data sheet for specific primer recomendations.

cl.x: Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (December 2025, Version 05.01) and the requirements below.

s: Thickness: ~0,66 mm

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Application Method / Tools
s: Sika® SealTape F tape
Embed tape into the 1st layer of the wet Sika® waterproofing product using a smoothing trowel or spatula. To accommodate movement, a loop can be made with the tape over the crack.
Overlaps must be ≥ 50 mm.
On top of the hardened 1st layer and tape, apply a 2nd layer of the Sika® waterproofing product.

The middle section of the Sika® SealTape F can be left exposed with the selected waterproofing membrane bonding to a minimum 25mm over each edge of the tape. Tile adhesive can bond directly onto the Sika® SealTape F bandage.
Refer to the specific instruction on the product dat sheet of the selected Sika waterproofing membrane.
